panels.title: Retention Cohort Heatmap
panels.description: Доля пользователей, активных через N дней после первого просмотра. Пустая ячейка означает, что день ещё не наступил.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(metric_date) AS `Когорта`, maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '0') AS `Day 0`, maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '1') AS `Day 1`, maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '2') AS `Day 2`, maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '3') AS `Day 3`, maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '4') AS `Day 4`, maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '5') AS `Day 5`, maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '6') AS `Day 6`, maxOrNullIf(value, dimension = '7') AS `Day 7` FROM cinema.daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'retention' AND $__dateFilter(metric_date) GROUP BY metric_date HAVING isNotNull(`Day 0`) ORDER BY metric_date DESC
SELECT toDateTime(metric_date, 'UTC') AS time, value AS DAU FROM cinema.daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'dau' AND $__dateFilter(metric_date) ORDER BY time
SELECT toDateTime(metric_date, 'UTC') AS time, value AS `Доля завершённых` FROM cinema.daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'conversion' AND $__dateFilter(metric_date) ORDER BY time

SELECT dimension AS `Фильм`, sum(value) AS `Просмотры` FROM cinema.daily_metrics WHERE metric = 'movie_views' AND $__dateFilter(metric_date) GROUP BY dimension ORDER BY `Просмотры` DESC, `Фильм` LIMIT 10
